name: Danville Dining District
description: Four restaurants on one corner at the south end of Hartz Avenue in downtown Danville: Rancho Cantina, Incontro Ristorante, Kaia's Island Kitchen & Tiki Bar and Danville Harvest. Search brunch, lunch, dinner, late night, private dining, catering, takeout, delivery and industry specials, see tonight's late board, and plan a two-stop night.
walking_note: Every pairing is under a one-minute walk with at most one street crossing. The Hartz and Church crossing was rebuilt in 2024 with bulb-outs and new lighting.

parking.name: Village Theatre Lot
parking.note: Closest lot, about 1 minute. 2-hour and 4-hour sections, EV charging, free.

parking.name: Front Street Lot

parking.name: Railroad Avenue Lot
parking.address: Railroad Ave between Prospect Ave and Church St
parking.note: 2 and 4-hour sections, EV charging, free. Farmers' market Saturdays 9 to 1.

parking.name: Clock Tower Lot

street_parking: Hartz Ave, Church St and School St are 2-hour street parking. Downtown has 1,400 free public spaces across six municipal lots.

landmarks.name: Village Theatre & Art Gallery
landmarks.note: 1874 Grange Hall turned town theatre and gallery, 1 to 2 minutes up Church St. Catch a show, then dinner.

landmarks.name: Iron Horse Trail at Church St
landmarks.note: The regional trail passes one short block down Church St behind the Railroad Ave lot.

landmarks.name: Museum of the San Ramon Valley
landmarks.note: Restored 1891 depot at Railroad and Prospect.

landmarks.name: Prospect Park Plaza
landmarks.note: Renovated 2025, free Music at the Plaza evenings.

landmarks.name: Town Green
landmarks.note: Music in the Park and Moonlight Movies on summer weekends.

landmarks.name: Danville Farmers' Market
landmarks.note: Saturdays 9 AM to 1 PM in the Railroad Ave lot, then brunch on the corner.

landmarks.name: The Old Oak Tree
landmarks.note: 350-year-old valley oak, lit the Friday after Thanksgiving.

landmarks.name: Danville Hotel
landmarks.note: 1892 hotel block at Hartz and Prospect.

competitor_zone.where: North end of Hartz Ave around Prospect Ave
competitor_zone.description: Danville's louder block: a 1907 dive bar, a music club, a cocktail lounge open to midnight and a brewery. South of Hartz is dinner-led instead: patios, wood fire, tiki and wine, with the last kitchens closing between 8:30 and 11.

chamber.programs: Monthly mixers, Member-to-Member Deals, Lighting of the Old Oak Tree, Oktoberfest walking tour, Fallfest.
